docs.text: title: Start your code | text: Code needs a "hat block" on top to tell it when to start. Try "when green flag clicked."
title: Run your project | text: Click the green flag above the stage to run your project!
title: Move a sprite | text: Make your sprite move with the "move" block
title: Keyboard controls | text: Use "when key pressed" with a motion block to control your sprite with the keyboard
title: Change x | text: Use "change x by" for left and right movement
title: Go to a spot | text: Use "go to x y" to put your sprite in a specific place
title: Smooth movement | text: Use "glide" for smooth movement.
title: Add a sound | text: Go to the Sounds tab to add sounds, then use the "play sound" block
title: Record a sound | text: In the Sounds tab, click the microphone button to record your own sound!
title: Wait for sound | text: "Play sound until done" waits for the sound to finish before continuing to the next block.
title: Speech bubbles | text: Use the "say" or "think" blocks to make a speech bubble appear
title: Change costume | text: Use "next costume" to change how your sprite looks, and animate it
title: Add costumes | text: Go to the Costumes tab, then click the cat button at the bottom to add a new costume
title: Animate | text: Put "next costume" inside a "forever" loop to make a simple animation
title: Repeat forever | text: Use a "forever" block to make something repeat over and over
title: Repeat 10 | text: Use "repeat" to do something a specific number of times
title: Slow it down | text: Add a "wait" block to slow things down
title: Make a variable | text: Click "Make a Variable" in the Variables category to keep track of things like score
title: Update a variable | text: Use "set" variable at the beginning, then "change" to update it. Try making a clicker game!
title: Use lists | text: Click "Make a List" under Variables to store a list of things, like names or numbers
title: Detect collisions | text: Use the "touching" block in a forever loop to check when a sprite touches the mouse pointer, the edge of the stage, or another sprite
title: Send messages | text: Use "broadcast" and "when I receive" to send messages. A different sprite can receive the message.
title: Add a sprite | text: Click the "add sprite" button below the stage to add a new sprite to your project
title: Change backdrop | text: Click the button below the stage to add a backdrop, then try "next backdrop"
title: Make a game | text: A simple game could start with keyboard controls, something to collect or avoid, and a variable to keep score
title: Clone sprites | text: Use "create clone" to make temporary copies of a sprite.
title: Add extensions | text: Click the blue "Add Extension" button at the bottom-left to get extra blocks to do things like draw, play musical notes, or speak out loud.
title: Fix volume | text: Can't hear anything? Maybe the volume was set to 0. Use "set volume to 100%" to fix it!
title: Unhide sprite | text: Can't see your sprite? It might be hidden! Click the "show" eye icon in the sprite info area, or use the "show" block.
title: Fade with ghost effect | text: You can use the ghost effect to make your sprite fade out. Click the green flag or stop button to remove the effect.
title: Find sprite | text: You can use "go to x: 0 y: 0" to bring a sprite back to the center.
title: Stop everything | text: Click the red stop button to stop all running scripts.
title: Check which sprite | text: Code not running? Make sure you added it to the right sprite! Click the sprite you want in the sprite pane, then check its code.

title: Fix color detection | text: If "touching color" isn't working, make sure you picked the exact right color. Click the color on the block then use the eyedropper tool to select it from the stage.
title: Add a wait | text: If things happen too fast to see, try adding "wait" blocks between actions.
title: Block order | text: Blocks in a stack run one at a time, from top to bottom.
title: Do two things at once | text: You can run two stacks at the same time! Use two "when green flag clicked" blocks to do things in parallel.
title: Keep checking | text: "If" checks only once! Wrap it inside a "forever" loop to keep checking over and over.
title: Try a block | text: You can click on any block in the workspace to try it! Click a whole stack to run all of them. They'll highlight in yellow while they're running.
title: Remove a block | text: To remove a block from the middle of a stack, first drag away the ones under it. Then you can remove the block, and reconnect the rest.
title: Why no effect? | text: Blocks that undo each other (like "turn 15" then "turn -15") happen so fast you won't see anything. Try adding "wait" blocks between them.
title: Go backward | text: Use a minus sign (-) to make negative numbers. For example, "move -10 steps" makes your sprite go backward.
title: Use decimals | text: You can use decimal numbers like 0.5. Try "wait 0.5 seconds" for a shorter pause, or "move 0.5 steps" for smaller movements.
title: Compare numbers | text: The pointy symbols compare numbers: < means "less than" and > means "greater than." The open end faces the bigger number.
title: Dynamic values | text: You can drag any round reporter block into an input on another block to make it dynamic.
title: Duplicate blocks | text: Right-click on a block to duplicate it or add a comment.
title: Stage coordinates | text: The stage is like a grid: X goes left (-240) to right (240), and Y goes bottom (-180) to top (180), with center at (0, 0).
title: Draw with Pen | text: Add the Pen extension to draw lines and shapes as your sprite moves. Try "pen down" + "move" + "turn" in a loop.
title: Play music | text: Add the Music extension to play drums and instruments — use it in a loop to make a beat!
title: Sprite talks out loud | text: Add the Text to Speech extension to make your sprite actually talk out loud!
title: Use random | text: Use the "pick random" block for random positions, sizes, or colors
title: Ask a question | text: Use the "ask" block to ask the user a question. The response goes into the "answer" block.
title: Use the timer | text: Use the "timer" block to measure how long something takes.
title: Change size | text: Use "change size" to make your sprite grow or shrink
title: Visual effects | text: Try "set effect" to apply color, fisheye, whirl, pixelate, mosaic, brightness, and ghost effects to your sprite
title: Stamp copies | text: Use "stamp" from the Pen extension to leave a picture of your sprite on the stage.

title: Sound timing | text: "Start sound" starts the sound then keeps going to the next block. "Play sound until done" waits for it to finish before continuing. Use the "until done" version for music loops.
title: Backdrop triggers | text: Use "when backdrop switches to" to do something when the scene changes.
title: Follow mouse | text: Use "go to mouse-pointer" to make a sprite stick to your mouse!

title: Variable display | text: Check the box next to a variable in the menu to show its monitor on the stage. Right-click the monitor to change how it looks. You can make it a slider to tweak the values, too.
title: Reset at start | text: Put "go to x: y:" and "point in direction 90" under "when green flag clicked" to reset your sprite at the start.
title: Delete clones | text: You can use "delete this clone" under "when I start as a clone" to make it go away.
title: Repeat until | text: Use "repeat until" to keep doing something until a condition is met, like moving until you reach the edge
title: Stop block | text: Use "stop all" to stop everything, or try the other options: stop this script, or stop other scripts in this sprite.
title: Rainbow colors | text: Put "change color effect" inside a forever loop to make your sprite cycle through rainbow colors
title: Spin around | text: Put "turn 15 degrees" inside a forever loop to make your sprite spin! Change the number to spin faster or slower.
title: Pulse effect | text: Make your sprite pulse! Use "change size by 5" and "wait", then "change size by -5" and "wait" in a forever loop.
title: Remix sounds | text: Use "change pitch effect" to make sounds higher or lower
title: Fix rotation | text: If "turn" doesn't seem to work, check the rotation style in the sprite info area. If it's is set to "left-right" or "don't rotate", change it to "all around."
title: Fix costume center | text: If your sprite rotates weirdly, the costume center point might be off. Go to the Costumes tab and center your drawing on the crosshairs.

title: Follow a sprite | text: Use "point towards [sprite]" and a move block inside a "forever" loop to make one sprite follow another.
title: Bounce up & down | text: One way to bounce is "repeat 10: change y by 5" then "repeat 10: change y by -5" inside a forever loop.
title: Copy code to sprite | text: You can drag a stack of blocks from onto a another sprite in the sprite selector, to copy it there.
title: Face left (no flip) | text: Set rotation style to "left-right" in the sprite info area. Then your sprite will flip horizontally without going upside down
title: Hold key to move | text: Use "forever if key pressed" instead of "when key pressed" for smooth, continuous movement
title: Go back to start | text: Use "go to x: 0 y: 0" to send a sprite back to the center
title: Upload a sound | text: To add your own audio file, go to the Sounds tab, hover over the speaker button, and choose "Upload Sound" to pick a file from your computer
title: Falling obstacles | text: To make a sprite fall from the sky, start it at the top with "go to x:0 y:180" then use "forever: change y by -5" to make it fall down!
title: Find X position | text: Select a sprite to see its x and y position in the sprite info area below, or use the "x position" reporter block
title: Random glide | text: Use "glide" to move smoothly to a random position, to your mouse pointer, or to another sprite.
title: Change y | text: Use "change y by" for up and down movement
title: Translate text | text: Add the Translate extension to make your sprite say words in another language
title: Video Sensing | text: Add the Video Sensing extension to use your webcam to sense movement.
title: Track your face | text: Add the Face Sensing extension to make a sprite stick to your nose, mouth, or eyes!
title: Makey Makey input | text: Use the Makey Makey extension with a Makey Makey board. Or trying adding a secret code to your project.
title: Point in direction | text: Use "point in direction" to face a specific way: 90 = right, -90 = left, 0 = up, 180 = down.
title: Point at something | text: Use "point towards" to face the mouse pointer or another sprite
title: Bounce off edges | text: Add "if on edge, bounce" inside a forever loop so your sprite turns when it hits the edge of the stage.
title: Set exact size | text: Use "set size to 100" for normal size. Try 50 for half size, or 200 for double size.
title: Hide a sprite | text: Use "hide" to make a sprite invisible, and "show" to make it appear again.
title: Stop sounds | text: Use "stop all sounds" to silence everything that's playing
title: When sprite clicked | text: Use "when this sprite clicked" to make a sprite react to clicks.
title: Broadcast and wait | text: Use "broadcast and wait" to send a message and wait there until every receiver finishes running code that was triggered by it.
title: If / else | text: Use "if / else" to do one thing when a condition is true and a different thing otherwise.
title: Wait until | text: Use "wait until" to pause your code until something happens, like a sprite touching another, or a key being pressed.
title: Measure distance | text: Use "distance to" to find how far away the mouse pointer or another sprite is.
title: Sense loudness | text: Use "loudness" to react to your microphone.
title: Click and hold | text: Use "mouse down?" to check if the mouse button is being held down.
title: Compare with equals | text: Use the "=" operator to check if two things match, like comparing the answer to a quiz question.
title: Join words | text: Use "join" to combine chunks of text.
title: Make your own block | text: Click "Make a Block" in the My Blocks category to define your own custom block

title: Thought bubble | text: Use "think" to show what your character is thinking about.
title: Switch to a costume | text: Use "switch costume to" with a costume's name to change a sprite's look: their pose, mood, outfit, dance move, species, or whatever else you can imagine.
title: Set x position | text: "Set x to" moves your sprite to a horizontal position. The stage goes from x = -240 on the left, to x = 240 on the right.
title: Read your direction | text: The "direction" reporter shows which way your sprite is pointing — 0 is up, 90 is right, 180 is down, -90 is left. Drop it into another block to use it.
title: Use math | text: Use the math blocks for + − × ÷. Drop numbers (or reporters!) into the slots. Try "say (5 + 3)" to see the answer pop up!
title: Use "and" to check two things | text: The "and" block checks if two things are true at once.
title: Track the mouse | text: "Mouse x" and "mouse y" report where the mouse pointer is on the stage. Drop them into other blocks to follow or react to it.
title: Reset the timer | text: Use "reset timer" to start counting from zero: perfect for starting a new round or measuring how long something takes.
title: Get info from another sprite | text: Use "[__] of [sprite]" to read another sprite's x, y, direction, costume, or size. Great for making one sprite react to another.
title: Fade out a sound | text: Put "change volume by -10" inside a repeat to fade music out smoothly, or use +10 to fade it in. Remember to reset it to 100% at the start.
title: Add to a list | text: Lists hold many items. Make one in Variables, then use the "add to list" block to add numbers, answers, scores, or words.
title: Read from a list | text: Use "item of list" to get a specific item from a list. Item 1 is the first one.
title: Count list items | text: "Length of list" tells you how many items it has.
